name: @nubscarson/plugin-agentnet
description: AgentNet on-chain skill marketplace for elizaOS agents: catalog search, free skill equip, and wallet profiles over public HTTP/RPC; the gated write tier (buy, publish, posts, soul, memory) fronts the official @iqlabs-official/agentnet-mcp stdio server and stays OFF by default behind AGENTNET_ALLOW_WRITES and AGENTNET_ALLOW_SPEND.
author: NubsCarson

AGENTNET_ALLOW_WRITES.description: Master gate for the write tier. Off (default) means no wallet process is ever spawned and every write action refuses. Set 1/true/yes/on to enable.

AGENTNET_ALLOW_SPEND.description: Second gate, required on top of AGENTNET_ALLOW_WRITES for value-moving tools (buy_skill, publish_skill). Off by default.

AGENTNET_WALLET_KEYFILE.description: Solana keypair JSON path for the spawned agentnet-mcp server (created if missing). Its balance is the hard spend ceiling. Ignored in steward signer mode.

AGENTNET_SIGNER.description: Where the server's signing key lives: keyfile (default, local keypair) or steward (remote Steward policy-vault signer bridge; no locally armed key).

AGENTNET_STEWARD_SIGNER_URL.description: Required with AGENTNET_SIGNER=steward: URL of a running Steward signer bridge. Probed live (GET /pubkey) before any spawn; never falls back to the keyfile.

AGENTNET_SIGNER_HOOK.description: Operator assertion that the spawned server build ships the AGENTNET_WALLET_REMOTE signer hook. The assertion alone arms nothing; the live bridge probe must also pass.

AGENTNET_WALLET_REMOTE_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the Steward signer bridge, forwarded to the spawned server and used by the pre-spawn probe.

AGENTNET_MCP_COMMAND.description: Full spawn command line for the write-tier server, whitespace split. Point at a pinned local build to skip npx.

AGENTNET_NETWORK.description: Solana network forwarded to the server. Use devnet for testing.

AGENTNET_SKILLS_DIR.description: Where the read tier equips free skills as SKILL.md files; also forwarded (via AGENTNET_SKILL_DIRS) so bought skills land where the eliza skills loader scans.

AGENTNET_SKILL_DIRS.description: Extra comma-separated skill directories forwarded to the spawned server on top of AGENTNET_SKILLS_DIR.

AGENTNET_INDEXER_URL.description: Read-tier catalog indexer endpoint (mainnet default). Also forwarded to the server.

AGENTNET_GATEWAY_URL.description: Read-tier gateway endpoint for profiles and inscriptions (mainnet default). Also forwarded to the server.

AGENTNET_RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint for read-tier metadata lookups (public mainnet default).

AGENTNET_HOME.description: State root forwarded to the spawned server when set.

AGENTNET_ELIZA_CHARACTER.description: Path to the character.json that receives the soul persona, forwarded to the spawned server when set.
